name: Pristine Spider Silk
label: Item
description: Stormwind mages seek Pristine Spider Silk for robes woven to endure enchantments. The fine thread comes from venomous spiders in Duskwood.
intro: Stormwind mages seek Pristine Spider Silk for robes woven to endure enchantments. The fine thread comes from venomous spiders in Duskwood.

p: Stormwind mages need silk strong enough to bear enchantments and the wear of an adept. Tailors use common spider silk, but the strands gathered from carrion recluses and black widow hatchlings in Duskwood are more resilient. Mages from the Wizard's Sanctum send rising adepts into those woods to collect the silk. Master tailor Wynne Larson then weaves it into a robe for an adept.
